title: Two-minute exposure check
description: Ten quick questions for UK firms with five to 50 staff. Get a score out of 10 and your cyber security gaps in order. Your answers stay in your browser.
intro: Ten quick questions, about two minutes, for UK firms with five to 50 staff. You get a score out of 10 and your gaps in order, with a way to turn them into a plan.

title: Cyber Essentials readiness check
description: Five questions based on the Cyber Essentials v3.3 changes. See what to fix before you book an assessment.
intro: Five questions, about a minute, based on the Cyber Essentials changes described in the report. See what to fix before you book an assessment.

title: Email your IT provider
description: The four questions every small business should ask its IT provider, plus a fifth about backups, turned into an email you can copy or open in your own mail app.
intro: Add your IT provider's name and your own, then copy the email or open it in your mail app. The questions come from the report. Nothing is sent from this page.

title: Call-back rule poster
description: Print an A4 poster for the office wall: no change to bank details or urgent payment without a phone call to a number you already hold.
intro: Add your business name and who to ask, then print an A4 poster for everyone who touches payments. The rule is the one in the report. Nothing leaves your browser.
